_help: One entry per 3D model shown on the site. Add an entry here and it appears: no code. Fields: id (unique), title, glb (path from docs/), caption (optional), page (home or models: where it is embedded), section (heading on the models page), poster (optional image shown until the model loads), camera (optional: orbit like '35deg 70deg auto', target, fov).
